name: ctm
description: Context and Token Manager: keeps the model informed about its context window and the 5-hour / 7-day rate limits, each with its change since the last report, and lets it compact or clear itself – always with a resume prompt.

intervalMinutes.title: Update interval (minutes)
intervalMinutes.description: Default for how often CTM attaches the current figures while the model works, and the interval of idle updates and limit wake-up checks (1–60). The model (settings tool) or /ctm interval can override it.

compactThreshold.title: Compact threshold
compactThreshold.description: Context size from which CTM reminds the model to compact when its task allows: tokens (300k) or percent of the window (30%). 'off' = no threshold and no reminders to ask. Empty = unset: CTM nudges the model now and then to ask you for one. The model (settings tool) or /ctm compact can override it.

fiveHourPauseAt.title: Pause at 5-hour limit (%)
fiveHourPauseAt.description: From this usage of the 5-hour limit on, CTM asks the model to pause and wake itself once it is back below. 0 = off.

sevenDayPauseAt.title: Pause at 7-day limit (%)
sevenDayPauseAt.description: From this usage of the 7-day limit on, CTM asks the model to pause and wake itself once it is back below. 0 = off.

resetCooldownMinutes.title: Minimum time between compact/clear (minutes)
resetCooldownMinutes.description: Guards against loops in which the model keeps resetting itself.

attachToPrompts.title: Attach figures to your prompts
attachToPrompts.description: Attaches the current figures for the model to every prompt you send.

timeZone.title: Time zone (IANA)
timeZone.description: Time zone for every time CTM shows, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Empty = detect automatically (TZ, /etc/localtime, system), else UTC.
